evals.name: medium-new-hook
evals.prompt: Plan the implementation for adding a UserPromptSubmit hook to baton. Medium-complexity task.

assertions.name: alternatives-presented
assertions.description: Presents 2+ fundamentally different approaches with trade-offs, not just one approach

assertions.name: impact-analysis
assertions.description: Identifies specific files that need to change and why (manifest.conf, new hook script, settings.json, adapter files)

assertions.name: risks-identified
assertions.description: Identifies at least 1 concrete risk or edge case (e.g., what constitutes a 'bypass attempt' in a prompt)

assertions.name: verification-path
assertions.description: Specifies how to verify the implementation works (test commands, expected behavior)

assertions.name: diff-predictable
assertions.description: Human could predict the approximate diff from reading the plan — specific enough about what changes where

evals.name: small-bugfix
evals.prompt: Plan the fix for bash-guard false positive: patch --dry-run being blocked. Small task.

assertions.name: proportional-depth
assertions.description: Plan is appropriately lightweight for a Small task — under 80 lines, no full Surface Scan table

assertions.name: fix-specified
assertions.description: Specifies the actual fix clearly enough to implement (what code to change and how)

assertions.name: test-plan
assertions.description: Includes how to verify the fix (test command or expected behavior)

assertions.name: no-over-engineering
assertions.description: Does NOT include unnecessary sections like full First Principles Decomposition or 3-question Self-Challenge for a single-file bugfix

assertions.name: scope-bounded
assertions.description: Clearly states what files change and that scope is limited to bash-guard.sh

evals.name: trivial-typo
evals.prompt: Plan a Trivial change: fix a typo in README.md.

assertions.name: minimal-output
assertions.description: Plan is 3-10 lines total — a trivial inline contract, not a structured document

assertions.name: no-process-overhead
assertions.description: Does NOT include Steps 1-6, Surface Scan, Self-Challenge, or Review Pass for a typo fix

assertions.name: actionable
assertions.description: States what to change clearly enough to act on immediately

assertions.name: fast-execution
assertions.description: Completed in under 60 seconds and under 15k tokens
